'''Maarten Rossou Revenge of the CC Engineer''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Maarten Rossou]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds120.htm Revenge of the CC Engineer], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228072907/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds120.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Maarten Rossou]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
